Situations / Nonas Favor

Nona’s Favor

Perrin agreed to Nona‘s favor before she stated what it was. She gave him a sending stone and he left.

The Favor (canon)

Word reached Nona that Perrin came into Calveno with a crew including a face nobody here knows: a blue Grung in a beret and moustache (Jean-Claude). She reads this as a stroke of luck. She’s been getting reports she would normally dismiss as impossible this far north — Grung moving in the old Warren tunnels that intersect the Calveno sewers. She wants them confirmed or dismissed. And who better to send hunting Grung than a Grung.

The ask: send Jean-Claude (with whoever he wants) into the old tunnels to confirm whether the Grung reports are real.

This is the door into the raid. Those sewer Grung are Simone’s extraction crews mapping the Day-4 egress route. Nona’s favor and the handler thread are the same investigation from two ends — the street above and the tunnels below. The favor puts the Warren’s blessing behind the descent.

What Led Here

  • Perrin missed his check-in with Nona; she assumed capture, set attacks in motion.
  • Perrin explained the Vestra’s fate (Leviathan; no survivors stated outright).
  • Nona called off the attacks; ordered consolation for Vestra crew.
  • Then asked the favor. Perrin said yes for her without conditions.

Pressures

  • The sending stone is active. Nona can contact Perrin at any time.
  • The favor is unknown — Perrin is committed regardless of what it turns out to be.
  • Nona is a Passage matriarch in Calveno. The favor is likely operationally significant.

World Update — Session 03

Roll: 14 — Partial Nona received Cobb’s report that Perrin’s crew includes a blue Grung in a beret and moustache. She sent Warren runners deeper into the tunnel network to confirm the Grung sighting reports and map entry points before calling in the favor. Runners confirmed the sightings are real — movement in old maintenance corridors beneath Le Paludi and the Bridge district, concentrated near canal intersections. Two reliable entry points identified. Nona has good intel and confirmation — she’s ready to call in the favor.

Session 04 — Favor Executed

Nona used the sending stone: “I need some work done. Come speak to me at the safe house. Bring your friends, especially the blue one, and anyone who can fight.” The favor: investigate Grung sightings in the Calveno sewers. Nona provided a map with 3 sighting locations, a Rattkin eyewitness, and Hero’s Feast from her cooking. The party entered the sewers, discovered Grung tunneling and black powder staging, destroyed one of six ships, killed a purple handler, and captured Felix Aho (green Grung laborer) who revealed the full bombing operation — 4 attack points, scaffolding with black powder against sewer ceilings, 2-day deadline timed to the festival. Nona received Felix as prisoner and declared: “I knew I chose the right people for the job.”

Resolution: the favor is complete. The sending stone relationship continues — Nona and Perrin now operate as active allies against the bombing threat. The obligation thread feeds directly into Calveno Beffa Grung Raid.

resolved

Nona's favor was to investigate Grung sightings in the sewers. Party completed it in Session 04 — exposed a coordinated bombing plot, captured Felix Aho, returned with full intel.
